title: BNPL Diamond: Understanding Your Maximum BNPL Limit and Concurrent Plans
summary: Explains BNPL Diamond limits: your total outstanding principal across all BNPL Diamond repayment plans must stay at or below $2,505,000.00, and you can have at most 25 active plans concurrently. New plans are declined if either cap would be exceeded; approvals require both criteria to remain within limits.
